title: Take a Low-Light Selfie Without a Front Flash Burst
description: Use steady screen light for a low-light selfie instead of a burst of front flash. Set the brightness before framing and check a saved test photo.
direct: Use steady screen light in the front-camera preview. Set the brightness before you frame the picture and take the selfie while the light is already on.
figureAlt: A person framing a selfie with an even glow from a phone screen
figureCaption: AI-generated illustration. The scene illustrates steady light from the phone while the subject composes the photo.
cards.decision.heading: Set a comfortable level while you compose
cards.decision.body: Start with a low, neutral light. Raise it until you can see your face and expression clearly. Use a room lamp as well if the phone screen alone is too dim.
sections.detail-1.heading: Give the camera more usable light
sections.detail-1.body: A steady screen helps you see the face before the shutter. In a very dim room it may still be insufficient. Turn toward a soft lamp, steady your elbows, and check a second photo at full size.
sections.detail-2.heading: Use the camera that can keep the light on
sections.detail-2.body: GlowPop provides its light in its own front-camera view. If you switch to another camera app, check that app’s own lighting settings. GlowPop does not change its flash behavior.
faqs.reader-1.heading: Should I use maximum screen brightness?
faqs.reader-1.body: Start low and increase the light until you can frame comfortably and see the face clearly.
faqs.reader-2.heading: Will steady light prevent every blurred photo?
faqs.reader-2.body: Movement and available light still matter. Check a saved test and add room light when needed.

steps.step-1.text: Open the front-camera preview in GlowPop: Selfie Glow Camera and set the screen light before you pose.
steps.step-2.text: Hold the phone at a comfortable distance. Adjust screen brightness while looking at the preview. If the light makes you squint, lower it or add light from the room.
steps.step-3.text: Hold still and take a test selfie. Check the saved photo for unwanted motion blur and uneven lighting before taking more.
